items.title: GENERAL MANAGER’S REPORT (DISCUSSION ONLY) a) Financial Matters b) Capital Report c) Property Management d) Recreation Programs e) Park, Recreation and Open Space Advisory Committee Report f) Events g) Legislation

GENERAL PUBLIC COMMENT - UP TO 15 MINUTES – THIS ITEM WILL BE CONTINUED TO ITEM 12 At this time, members of the public may address the Commission on items of interest to the public that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Commission and that do not appear on the agenda. With respect to agenda items, you will have opportunity to address the Commission when the item is reached in the meeting.
SAN FRANCISCO ZOO Presentation and discussion only to update the Commission on operational and management issues at the San Francisco Zoo. (DISCUSSION ONLY)

LET’SPLAYSF! STATUS Presentation and discussion only on the status of the Let’sPlaySF! Playgrounds initiative to renovate the 13 playgrounds prioritized by the Playgrounds Task Force. (DISCUSSION ONLY) Staff: Lisa Bransten – 831-2704 8. GENEVA CAR BARN & POWERHOUSE PHASE 1 PROJECT Discussion and possible action to amend the construction contract with Roebuck Construction, Inc. for the Geneva Car Barn & Powerhouse Phase 1 Project (Contract No. 1000006023) to increase the contract amount by up to $85,000 bringing the total to $9,179,030, which is greater than 10% over the original approved contract amount of $8,267,300. (ACTION ITEM) Staff: Melinda Sullivan – 581-2548

GOLDEN GATE PARK TENNIS CENTER Discussion and possible action to modify certain provisions (including with respect to the rent, operating hours, and summer schedule) of the proposed agreement with Lifetime Activities for the operations of the Golden Gate Park Tennis Center, due to the impact of COVID-19. (ACTION ITEM) Staff: Dana Ketcham – 831-6868

MERCED HEIGHTS PLAYGROUND Discussion and possible action to amend the construction contract with Treaty Construction Inc. for the Merced Heights Playground Project (Contract No. 1000010912 (R)) to increase the contract amount to $2,493,510 which is greater than 10% over the original approved contract amount of $2,142,000. (ACTION ITEM) Staff: Dan Mauer – 581-2542

CIVIC CENTER PLAZA PHASE 2 PAVEMENT MAINTENANCE PROJECT Discussion and possible action to award a contract to Cazadoro Construction Inc. (Contract No. 1000013712) for Phase 2 of the Civic Center Plaza Pavement Maintenance in the amount of $764,600. (ACTION ITEM) Staff: Alex Schuknecht – 215-9302

GENERAL PUBLIC COMMENT – CONTINUED FROM ITEM 4 IF NECESSARY At this time members of the public who were not able to address the Commission on Item 4 may address the Commission on items that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Recreation and Park Commission and that do not appear on the agenda.
CLOSED SESSION – CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – ANTICIPATED LITIGATION

COMMISSIONERS’ MATTERS This item is designed to allow Commissioners to raise issues they believe the Commission should address at future meetings. There will be no discussion of these items at this time.
